verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships AI features (First Pass AI, GenAI DDQ, AI Helpbot, MCP server), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of a control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The AI Helpbot transparency article only says the bot answers from approved support content, which does not address training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
